titulo: Labour party of ‘big money’, claims Greens’ Polanski as he says he will run for Starmer’s seat – UK politics live
cuerpo: Green party leader announces run in Holborn and St Pancras constituency in north London following the resignation of former PM Full report: Zack Polanski to stand in Keir Starmer seat as Green party candidate Kemi Badenoch will this morning be giving a speech saying the Conservatives would raise defence spending by £10bn a year, allowing the UK to reach the 3% of GDP target for defence spending by 2030. This is the target Andy Burnham has not committed to meeting . In a news release explaining where the Conservatives would find the money for this, they say: The uplift, worth £10bn per year, will be funded by further cuts to the spiralling welfare bill, building on the party’s existing pledges to cut welfare by £23bn, and by reprioritising funding from other areas. This represents the largest real-terms increase in defence spending in a generation … We will: Dodgy Tory economics won’t fund Britain’s defences. The British people won’t forget Kemi Badenoch’s Conservatives hollowed out our armed forces and blew holes in the UK’s proud international reputation.
